ENVIRONMENT  (--clearenv, then:)
  BASH_ENV         /var/lib/nowhere                set       markjoin
                     ← every non-interactive bash SOURCES this file at startup;
                       the value must be an absolute path, and one this profile
                       does not grant names a file the sandbox will not have
                     ← not granted
  CARGO_HOME       /home/u/.cargo                  set       markjoin
                     ← the config.toml under this path names a program cargo
                       runs — build.rustc-wrapper ran in place of rustc, as the
                       sandbox's own uid (measured, cargo 1.97.1)
  GIT_SSH_COMMAND  /var/lib/nowhere/ssh            set       markjoin
                     ← unchecked: snug has no type for this name
                     ← git runs this as the transport for every fetch and push,
                       with whatever ssh identity this sandbox was given
                       (measured, git 2.55.0)
                     ← not granted
  HOME             /home/u                         (snug)
  LOGNAME          u                               (snug)
  MY_TOOL_GRANTED  /home/u                         set       markjoin
                     ← unchecked: snug has no type for this name
  MY_TOOL_MODE     fast                            set       markjoin
                     ← unchecked: snug has no type for this name
  MY_TOOL_UNGRANTED /var/lib/nowhere                set       markjoin
                     ← unchecked: snug has no type for this name
                     ← not granted
  PATH             /home/u                         merge     markjoin
                     ← writable from inside
                   /usr/bin /bin /usr/sbin /sbin   (snug)    base
  PS1              🔒 snug:\w\$                     (snug)
  SHELL            /usr/bin/bash                   (snug)
  SNUG             1                               (snug)
  SNUG_PROFILES    @cwd-rw,@home,@parent-ro,@sys,markjoin (snug)
  SNUG_TARGET      /home/u/proj/sub                (snug)
  TMPDIR           /tmp                            (snug)
  USER             u                               (snug)
  XDG_CACHE_HOME   /home/u/.cache                  set       @home
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME  /home/u/.config                 set       @home
  XDG_DATA_HOME    /home/u/.local/share            set       @home
  XDG_STATE_HOME   /home/u/.local/state            set       @home
  PWD              /home/u/proj/sub                (bwrap)   --chdir
                     ← bwrap sets this from --chdir; snug does not
